messages:
Leah: Quick design review request — the Private setup wizard 'Connectivity checks' feels noisy. Can we make failures more prescriptive and less scary?
Omar: Agree. Current state shows a big red card with generic text. Suggestion: swap to an inline row-level hint with a short fix and a link to 'run diagnostics'. :point_down:
Kai: FWIW the preflight already runs lightweight checks, but UI just dumps raw logs. We can surface 3 categories: Critical (block), Fixable (suggest steps), Info.
Leah: Yes, separate blocking vs non-blocking. Blocking should prevent Next, but show one-click remediation where possible (e.g., open port vs suggest CIDR tweak).
Ruth: Accessibility note: when a check fails, screen readers should get an assertive announcement. Use aria-live="assertive" for the error summary and move keyboard focus to the first failed control.
Omar: UX microcopy suggestions: replace "Network error" with "Unable to reach instance — missing route or firewall rule." Short, actionable. Add a tooltip "Why this matters" linking to KB.
Kai: For devs we can include a compact command snippet to run in their environment. Eg:```bash
# test from bastion
curl -v http://<instance-ip>:8080/health
```Keep collapsed by default.
Leah: Nice — keep it collapsed so console stays clean. For mobile widths, show inline icon + brief text and expand to full details on click.
setup-bot: preflight scan completed: 3 checks run, 1 critical failure, 2 warnings. See details below.
Omar: On the flagged critical fail (CIDR overlap), the current message says "Invalid CIDR". Replace with: "CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 overlaps with your VPC routing — choose a non-overlapping private range (e.g., 192.168.0.0/16)". Add a 'Suggest new range' helper button.
Kai: Implementing 'Suggest new range' is fine; backend can propose a candidate CIDR from available pool. UI still needs a clear Accept / Preview changes step.
Ruth: Also add an accessible tooltip for the helper button — ensure it's keyboard reachable and has aria-describedby.
Leah: Agree. Also: rather than disabling Next entirely, show a yellow 'Continue with risks' option for non-blocking warnings with an inline confirmation modal explaining tradeoffs.
Omar: Copy tweak for the Continue option: "Proceed (I understand the risk: network connectivity may be degraded)". Keep it short.
Kai: Regarding 'Test connection' button — run it asynchronously and stream status updates. We should show a small spinner per-check and a live status line (passed/failed) instead of a global spinner. That reduces perceived waiting.
Ruth: For live updates, use polite aria-live for progress and assertive for final failure. Also ensure notifications aren't announced twice.
Leah: One more thing — in the list view, collapse repeated hints into a "Show similar issues" toggle. The logs are overwhelming for non-experts.
Omar: UX nit: move the primary action (Next) to the right and keep contextual help inline left, so keyboard users tab predictably.
Kai: I'll prototype the per-row controls and the suggest-CIDR flow. Can we agree on copy strings? I'll stub them in code as constants.
Leah: I'll post final copy suggestions in Figma and label items with A11y tags. Thanks all :thumbsup:
setup-bot: deploy-log: ux/prod/wizard-preflight v1.3 -> staged.
Omar: Quick follow-up — can we include a single-line KB link for common firewall fixes (AWS SG, GCP firewall, on-prem NAT)? Keeps support churn down.
Leah: Good call. Add a condensed one-click "Common fixes" dropdown that expands into platform-specific steps.
Ruth: And confirm color contrast for status badges. Red text on orange backgrounds has failed in previous audits. Use high-contrast palette and include textual status (Passed/Failed) for color-blind users.
Kai: I'll send a PR with markup examples and aria attributes. Targeting the next sprint.
Leah: Awesome. Meeting next Tuesday to review the prototype. Thanks everyone.
